entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Perf regression: json, json #65557
  • [Hot Reload] Running dotnet watch in WEBAPI template on the CLI will show an error "failed to read staticwebassets.development.json" due to missing file when NET11 Preview 2 is installed. #65550

Closed

  • Blazor JSInterop Flag to Serialize Non-Null Properties Only #65519
  • [OpenApi] Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi no longer includes Microsoft.AspNetCore.App framework reference #65410
    11.0-preview2
  • Perf improvement: kestrel-hostheader-mismatch #65546
  • Identity: IdentityUserContext does not use the virtual Property SchemaVersion which results in pending changes is no service provider is set #65449
